council.name: Jim Harrison
council.notes: Found to have breached Code of Conduct (verbal abuse, 2023). Accepted discipline: public apology + 15 days pay loss.

key_issues.title: Mayor Harrison Breached Code of Conduct — Verbal Abuse
key_issues.description: Integrity Commissioner found Mayor Jim Harrison breached sections 6.1 and 6.2 of Code of Conduct after incident following Feb 8, 2023 council meeting (discussion of vacant Sidney Ward seat). Commissioner recommended public apology + 15 days pay loss. Harrison accepted discipline January 2024. Two integrity commissioner investigations cost nearly $18,000 (revealed through FOI by Quinte News).

key_issues.title: Severe Debt and Reserve Crisis — Bottom 5 of 124 Ontario Municipalities
key_issues.description: Quinte West is in the bottom 5 of 124 Ontario municipalities for reserve-to-debt ratio. Owes $47 million to end of 2023 with another $19 million projected 2024-2025. Consumer and non-residential construction inflation rose 19% over four years while council budget increases totaled only 14%.

key_issues.title: CFB Trenton — Military Hub in Municipal Jurisdiction
key_issues.description: 8 Wing/CFB Trenton is located in Quinte West. Canada's largest air force base. Base Commander Col. Leif Dahl was permanently removed from command (Sep 2023) after being charged with careless firearms use, obstruction, and wildlife violations. Received conditional discharge — no criminal record.

key_issues.title: South East Public Health Closures
key_issues.description: South East Public Health announced closure of several locations including Quinte West, raising concerns about healthcare service delivery in the region.
